sentences.en: The steam is introduced into the pipes at about the pressure of the atmosphere, and is sucked through the system by means of a vacuum pump, which at the same operation frees the pipes from air and from condensation water.

sentences.en: I wouldn't tell that ninny if his shoes were on fire and he was standing at a leaky gas pump.

sentences.en: Clarissa sat her chair like a queen on a throne, the toe of a red pump and a white plaster clad foot peeping out from under her long gown.
sentences.vi: Clarissa ngồi trên chiếc ghế của mình như một nữ hoàng trên ngai vàng, mũi giày màu đỏ và bàn chân ốp thạch cao trắng ló ra sau chiếc áo choàng dài.
